prompts.name: tavern
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE small medieval fantasy game information-source UI mark. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match the simple solid white silhouette, mildly hand-cut edges, subtle tapered ends of MarketUI_Icons_v1. Pure white #FFFFFF flat fill, genuinely transparent background. No gray, no shading, no texture, no glow, no shadow, no typography, no border around image. Readable at 20 pixels: bold massing, few features, openings at least 8% of icon width, no hairline strokes, no disconnected specks. Center the mark on square canvas, generous 15% transparent margin all around. This will be uniformly scaled down to a 96x96 PNG and shown at 20-28px. Subject: A squat medieval drinking tankard with a large open loop handle protruding clearly to the RIGHT, a softly uneven foam lip. Bold cup body, no steam, no decorative lines. Distinct outer contour: low mug with side loop.
